items.evidence: Upon satisfaction of a threshold performance goal, each named executive may be awarded a maximum amount of incentive compensation of 0.2% of our Company's net income
2016 grants tied to Company's RORCE ranking compared to the Financial Performance Peer Group, subject to absolute performance levels
If our Company's three-year average RORCE is equal to or greater than the specified maximum absolute performance level, the 2016 Performance Share award would result in vesting at maximum.
